# Ente KSRTC - Online Bus Booking Platform

> Ente KSRTC is a web application for booking Kerala State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) bus tickets online.

This application provides a modern and responsive user interface for booking bus tickets. It includes features for searching buses, selecting seats, and viewing live bus tracking.

## Pages and Components
- **Home:** Search for buses, view quick booking options.
- **Search Results:** View available buses, select seats.
- **Live Tracking:** Track bus locations in real-time.
- **Profile:** Manage account settings, view booking history.

## Development Stack
- React
- Vite
- Custom CSS with modern glassmorphism UI

## Structure
The application has a mobile-first responsive design (`mobile/` components) and a desktop preview mode for the website version.
